To resist fake-listener farms, divide each subscriber's royalty budget only among works that subscriber played, and cap its total payouts at that subscriber's cleared payment after fees. Do not allocate a shared pool by global play counts or fund royalties from free trials. Aliases streaming their own recording can then recover at most their own payments, rather than siphon other listeners' budgets. Chargebacks must be resolved before releasing the corresponding royalties.
